SUTS-002 — SuperUnicode Regular Expressions

The second SuperUnicode Technical Specification: a UTS #18-analog regex engine with a bounded, allocation-free automaton.

SUTS-002 (SRE) is the second SuperUnicode Technical Specification. It is the SuperUnicode analog of UTS #18 (Unicode Regular Expressions): it adopts the same problem statement and the same Level 1 / Level 2 feature inventory, but reinterprets them over the full 64-bit SuperUnicode codepoint space and adds a third, kernel-specific level for the System Control Plane.

Zero-allocation, single-pass engine

Where a conventional engine backtracks over a dynamically grown NFA/DFA, SRE defines a bounded automaton held entirely in caller-provided storage. A pattern compiles once into a fixed set of states and edges; matching then simulates that automaton over a fixed-size state subset in linear time — O(N) time, O(1) extra space, with no heap and no backtracking.

Conformance levels

Level Name Coverage
Level 1 Basic SuperUnicode Support Full 31-bit addressing, SUCD script and category properties, canonical equivalence (SUCF-C), SCP invariance by default
Level 2 Extended System & Neography RNUR registry matcher (\p{RNUR}), SDF directional scope anchors (\b{LTR}, \b{RTL}), SBR line and word boundaries
Level 3 SCP & Kernel Diagnostics BANcode trap matching (\p{BANcode}) and explicit SCP directorial in-band anchors (\p{SCP_DIR_RTL})

Relationship to UTS #18

Dimension UTS #18 SUTS-002 SRE
Execution engine Backtracking NFA / dynamic heap allocation Zero-allocation linear automaton (O(N))
Space coverage 21-bit Unicode plane range (0x0000–0x10FFFF) Full 31-bit SUCS plus 64-bit ExtSUCS
Control handling Out-of-band flags or anchors In-band SCP directives and BANcode traps
Bridge vs Native Standard property sets (\p{L}) SUCD lookup for the Bridge + bitmask tests for Native / ExtSUCS

Property classes

  • Bridge — SUCD lookup for standard properties: \p{L}, \p{N}, \p{Arabic}, \p{Han}.
  • Native / ExtSUCS / SCP — direct bitmask tests: \p{Native}, \p{ExtSUCS}, \p{SCP}, \p{BANcode}.
  • Neography — \p{RNUR}, the SUTR-8 Native-plane neography registry (RCCR is a code registry, not a codepoint registry, and exposes no property).
#define SUTS_SRE_MAX_STATES 64U
#define SUTS_SRE_MAX_TRANSITIONS 128U
#define SUTS_SRE_MAX_CLASSES 8U
#define SUTS_SRE_MAX_CLASS_ITEMS 12U

typedef uint32_t suts_sre_flags_t;

#define SUTS_SRE_FLAG_NONE 0x00000000u
#define SUTS_SRE_FLAG_IGNORE_CASE 0x00000001u
#define SUTS_SRE_FLAG_MATCH_SCP 0x00000002u
#define SUTS_SRE_FLAG_SCF_NORMALIZED 0x00000004u
#define SUTS_SRE_FLAG_DIR_AWARE 0x00000008u
#define SUTS_SRE_FLAG_MULTILINE 0x00000010u
API Purpose
suts_sre_compile Compile an ASCII-meta pattern into a bounded automaton
suts_sre_prop_match SUCD-style property test for a codepoint
suts_sre_init_match / suts_sre_step Streaming match context; feed one codepoint in O(1)
suts_sre_match_at / suts_sre_search Anchored match and leftmost-then-longest search
Feature Status
Zero heap allocation, no state-table growth Yes
Linear O(N) matching, no backtracking Yes
64-bit extSUCS codepoint domain Yes
Character classes with union / intersection / difference Yes
Canonical equivalence (SUCF-C) under a flag Yes
SCP invariance by default; explicit \p{SCP} Yes
SDF directional anchors and multiline ^ / $ Yes

Reference implementation: include/suts/suts_sre.h + src/suts/suts_sre.c (freestanding C99, no heap), registered in suts_static.

Source of truth: docs/suts/SUTS-002-sre.md in the repository.
